headline: Three Games In And Win Pace Is Talking Absolute Rubbish
intro: Two to three games a side, so every team is either on pace for 82 wins or a perfect goose egg and the leaderboard is basically a coin toss with extra steps. Gooey leads on 144, Leon's right behind on 124, and Sam's at the bottom on −126 looking like a man who's picked a fight with the whole league. Treat all of this as vibes: the efficiency column is the only adult in the room, and it's got its own opinions about who's actually travelling.

players.name: Angus
players.text: Top of the pile on 144, and Goo will be insufferable about it. But peek at the efficiency number: 63.3, so the real total is less than half of what the pace is flattering him with. The Warriors Under and Pelicans Under are doing the heavy lifting on 0–3 starts, and the Suns Over is sitting at −29.5 by efficiency. Enjoy the view, Goo, the altitude is thin.

players.name: Leon
players.text: Mr Overs showing optimism has merit, at least for a fortnight. Five of six overs are in the black, with the Grizzlies, Blazers, Rockets and Pistons all winning, and the Nets Over at 0–2 is the only real smudge (−24.5, ouch). He actually leads the comp on efficiency at 92.5, so this isn't just small-sample fairy floss. Chinners is very much in the hunt.

players.name: Nic
players.text: Visdog is third on 69, and his Unders are doing exactly what Unders should: Knicks, Bucks and Kings all winless and banking +99.5 between them. The problem is the Blazers Under at 2–0 (−39.5), which is already a nasty one, and by efficiency his whole total is −0.7. The Thunder Over at 2–0 is quietly doing the business. Fine, but wobbly.

players.name: Marco
players.text: Marci is fourth on 20.7, which is a polite way of saying he's up on pace and down on efficiency (−24.7). The Wolves Over is the star at +33.5, but the Hornets Over is a mirage, with a 2–1 record hiding a −23.3 efficiency read. Wizards Under at −20.2 is also a concern, and the Cavs and Nuggets Overs are both treading water. A lot of ifs in this portfolio.

players.name: Ned
players.text: Ned sits fifth on −12, which for a man who didn't even draft is a strong early showing. The Magic and Nets Unders have both started 0–2 and are pocketing +68 between them. He's also copping −86.5 from the Thunder, Pistons and Rockets Unders all winning, so it's a feast-or-famine portfolio. Fading the group is working for now.

players.name: Roscoe the Dog
players.text: Roscoe's on −37.3 by pace, but the efficiency number is +26.4, so the pup is arguably the sharpest operator in the comp once you look under the hood. The Warriors Over at 0–3 is the −40.5 stinker dragging him down, and the Raptors Under at 2–0 is another early wound. Heat Under at 0–3 (+46.5) is the dog's best mate. Don't write him off, he's got the better underlying numbers than half of you.

players.name: Harry
players.text: Harry's on −43, and the Magic Over at 0–2 (−43.5) is basically the entire problem. Add the Wolves Under at 2–0 (−33.5) and you've got two picks wiping out every good thing he's done. The Wizards Over is the one shining light. It's early, but he's already deep into negative territory and in this comp a single −10 will kill ya.

players.name: Dan
players.text: Doccy is on −49.4 and, importantly, it's even worse by efficiency at −43.8, so there's no excuse to hide behind. The Spurs Over at 1–2 is bleeding −32.2 and the Lakers Under at 3–0 is bleeding −35.5, a combined −67.7 of pure suffering. The 76ers Over at 3–0 is the one cheerful thing in the portfolio. Doc needs a few of these to flip, fast.

players.name: Pos
players.text: Pos is on −89.3 and the efficiency is a rotten −76.6, so this isn't a fluke, it's a bad fortnight with receipts. Grizzlies Under at 2–0 (−52.5) and Heat Over at 0–3 (−46.5) are a brutal pair, and he's the only one holding both sides of the Spurs and Jazz and Kings in awkward spots. Spurs Under at +32.2 is the lifeline. It's early, but he's firmly in spoon-watch territory.

players.name: Sam
players.text: Sammy is last on −126, and the Knicks Over at 0–2 (−52.5) has done most of the damage on its own. Add the 76ers Under at 3–0 and the Bucks Over at 0–3 and it's a horror show. The one tiny mercy is that efficiency has him at −23.1, so the real number is far less grim than the headline. Still the spoon at the moment, and nobody's going to let him forget it.

signoff: May your unders tank and your overs thrive!
